main.description: A player's voice-clone reference, keyed in-app on their DID. Holds a provider-side model handle and explicit consent — never raw biometric data. One per player at the `self` rkey.

modelRef.description: Opaque handle to the voice model held by the VoiceCloner provider. Bardcast never stores the model itself.

sampleReplies.description: AT-URIs of the vox-pop reply records used as training samples (provenance).

status.description: 'ready' is required for a player to be voiced in a chapter. Feeds the readiness gate.

consent.description: Explicit, revocable consent to clone this voice. Required true to train or render.
